svg.title: DorkOS replaceable interfaces
svg.desc: Each row names a caller, its port, and implementations. A port is a code boundary, not necessarily a network boundary. Dashed edges identify the unwired Buzz implementation and planned decision-model consumers; decision bridges themselves exist.
